Name: Arachnid's Fang
Description: Poison applied to this +1 dagger seeps into the blade, awaiting the perfect moment for release. After a hit with the dagger but before damage is determined, the wielder of an arachnid’s fang can release a stored dose of poison into the creature struck by the blade as a free action. Up to 8 doses of poison can be stored in the dagger at a time, but only 1 dose can be released on a given attack.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, touch injection^{UC}

Name: Arrow of Charming
Description: When this +3 arrow strikes a creature, it explodes in a small cloud of red dust and deals nonlethal damage. The creature struck must succeed at a DC 16 Will save or be charmed by the wielder as charm monster. Alternatively, the user can inscribe the name of another creature into the arrow shaft; in this case, the arrow’s victim instead becomes charmed by the named creature on a failed save. Inscribing the arrow takes 10 minutes.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, charm monster

Name: Arrow Slicer
Description:
The blade of this +1 limning short sword pulsates with a faint blue glow when wielded. When its wielder is targeted by ranged attacks, an arrow slicer shines even brighter, alerting its user of the incoming danger and granting a +2 bonus on Perception checks to act in the surprise round.
Once per round when the wielder is targeted by an attack from a ranged weapon that uses nonfirearm ammunition, he can attempt a DC 20 Reflex saving throw as an immediate action to deflect the projectile. If he exceeds the DC by more than 5, he not only deflects the projectile but also slices it in half, and all foes within 30 feet that can see the wielder do so become shaken for 1d4 rounds; this is a fear effect and can affect a given creature only once per day.
Large projectiles, such as boulders hurled by giants and ballista bolts, can’t be deflected or cut in half.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, faerie fire, wind wall^{UM}

Name: Arrow Splitter
Description:
This +5 second chance^{UE} longbow is made of supple willow that forever looks freshly carved. When the wielder hits a foe multiple times with the bow, the arrows land in the same spot, driving their way deeper. A creature struck by an arrow fired from an arrow splitter takes an additional 1d6 points of precision damage for each arrow fired from an arrow splitter that has struck the creature within the same round.
For example, if a creature is struck by three arrows fired from an arrow splitter in the same round, the first arrow deals damage as normal, the second arrow deals an additional 1d6 points of precision damage, and the third arrow deals an additional 2d6 points of precision damage.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, ricochet shot^{UC}, sonic thrust^{UM}

Name: Assassin's Blade
Description:
This +1 dagger is forged for assassins alone. It allows slayers, rogues, and assassins who work for an assassins’ guild the chance to finish the job if their initial strikes prove less than successful.

If the wielder of this blade studies his target for 3 rounds (which can be the same 3 rounds of study for a death attack) either unseen or without being recognized as an enemy, he can sneak attack with all attacks he makes with this dagger against that target for the next 3 rounds. If his target has improved uncanny dodge, the wielder of the blade must be 4 levels higher than the target in order to sneak attack.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, guidance, instant enemy

Name: Assassin's Dagger
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 150, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 471
Description: This wicked-looking, curved +2 dagger provides a +1 bonus to the DC of a Fortitude save forced by the death attack of an assassin.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, slay living

Name: Avalanche Sling Staff
Description: Three times per day, the wielder of this +3 halfling sling staff can launch a stone (not a sling bullet) that explodes in mid-flight to create a stone call^{APG} effect centered on the target square.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, stone call^{APG}

Name: Axe of Felling
Description:
Born from dwarven forges, these +1 giant-bane dwarven waraxes are crafted in the likeness of the favored weapon of King Harral, the last king of the Pious Kingdom of Saggorak. According to legend, before he and his comrades starved to death during the orc siege of Saggorak, King Harral challenged and defeated an ettin in single combat by hacking its legs from beneath its body with his axe.
An axe of felling possesses the trip weapon feature and can be used to trip opponents up to two size categories larger than its wielder.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bull's strength, summon monster I

Name: Axe of Forced Life
Description:
This +3 battleaxe has a well-worn haft and a blackened blade etched with an ouroboros. An axe of forced life briefly disrupts the damage reduction of undead creatures. Once per round when the wielder strikes an undead creature that has DR/bludgeoning, DR/good, DR/magic, or DR/piercing, the wielder can reduce the target’s damage reduction by 5 points (to a minimum of 0). This effect lasts for 1 round, and reduces only the types of damage reduction listed.
On a confirmed critical hit, the wielder may reduce the target’s damage reduction by up to 15 points. The effects of multiple axes of forced life don’t stack, and the effects of an axe of forced life do not stack with the effects of a negating^{UE} weapon.
Once per day as a move action, the wielder of an axe of forced life may cause life energy to course through the weapon for 1 minute. Doing so causes the axe’s ouroboros to shed light as a candle. Thereafter, the first undead creature struck by the axe must succeed at a DC 17 Will save or lose the benefits of all forms of damage reduction it possesses except DR/epic for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, breath of life, dispel evil

Name: Bane Baldric
Description: This +1 baldric (a type of sword belt) grants its wearer the ability to grant the bane weapon special ability to any one melee weapon she wields for up to 10 rounds per day. These rounds need not be consecutive. Activating this ability is a swift action. The wearer chooses the creature type or subtype when activating the ability. The weapon gains the bane property against that creature type or subtype for the duration.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, summon monster I

Name: Banshee’s Howl
Description: This +2 thundering burst warhammer wails when swung. On a critical hit, the target is also affected as if by wail of the banshee (Fortitude DC 23 negates). This effect occurs only once per round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, wail of the banshee

Name: Bastard's Sting
Description:
This +2 adamantine bastard sword becomes a +5 unholy adamantine bastard sword in the hands of an antipaladin.
While wielded by an antipaladin, a bastard’s sting deals 2d6 points of negative energy damage to all living creatures that start their turn adjacent to the wielder. The antipaladin also gains fast healing 5 as long as at least one living creature takes damage from this negative energy. This negative energy has no effect on undead. The sword also enables the antipaladin to use unholy blight at will on command at the class level of the antipaladin.
Paladins take a –2 saving throw penalty against this effect.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, unholy aura, unholy blight, creator must be evil

Name: Battleaxe, Adamantine
Description: This adamantine battleaxe ignores hardness less than 20 when sundering weapons or attacking objects.

Name: Beam Cannon
Description: A beam cannon fires a ray of coherent light as a ranged touch attack with a range increment of 120 feet. It deals 6d6 points of fire damage on a successful hit. The cannon has 20 charges and consumes 1 charge per shot.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Technological Item, scorching ray

Name: Beast Wrestler's Gauntlets
Description: These +2 gauntlets grant the wearer a +4 competence bonus on combat maneuver checks to grapple animals, magical beasts, and vermin. Once per day, the wearer can cast beast shape I (self only) as a standard action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, beast shape I

Name: Beaststrike Club
Description: This +1 club allows the wielder to add her unarmed strike damage to the club’s damage when making a melee attack with it. If the wielder does not have the Improved Unarmed Strike feat, she provokes attacks of opportunity as normal for making an unarmed strike.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bull’s strength

Name: Biting Bracelet
Description: This +1 spiked gauntlet appears to be a simple metal bracelet until donned. Three times per day, as a swift action, the wearer can cause the bracelet to transform into a spiked gauntlet for 5 minutes. While transformed, the gauntlet grants a +2 competence bonus on grapple combat maneuver checks.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, alter self

Name: Blade of Binding
Description: This +1 longsword can bind extraplanar creatures. On a successful hit against an outsider, the wielder can attempt to cast dimensional anchor (CL 10th) on the target as a free action. This ability can be used three times per day.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, dimensional anchor

Name: Blade of the Rising Sun
Description: This +2 flaming burst katana sheds light as a torch when drawn. On a successful critical hit, the target must succeed at a DC 18 Fortitude save or be blinded for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, flame strike

Name: Blade of the Sword-Saint
Description:
This +5 keen speed katana is said to be the chosen weapon of a legendary sword-saint. When wielded by a samurai or cavalier, the blade grants a +4 insight bonus on initiative checks and a +4 competence bonus on critical confirmation rolls.

Once per day as a swift action, the wielder can enter a state of perfect focus for 1 minute. During this time, the wielder treats all rolls of 15–20 on the d20 as natural 20s for the purpose of confirming critical hits with this weapon.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, keen edge, haste, moment of prescience

Name: Bloatstrike Tail
Description: This +1 scorpion whip is made from the preserved tail of a monstrous vermin. On a successful hit, the wielder can cause the target to swell grotesquely; the target must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or become sickened for 1d4 rounds. This ability can be used three times per day.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, ray of enfeeblement

Name: Bloodletting Kukri
Description: This +1 wounding kukri grants its wielder a +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks to perform a bleed combat maneuver. In addition, whenever the wielder confirms a critical hit with the bloodletting kukri, the target takes 1 point of Constitution damage.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bleed, vampiric touch

Name: Bloodstone Impaler
Description: This +1 spear is tipped with a jagged bloodstone crystal. On a successful critical hit, the target takes 1 point of Constitution damage. Once per day, when the wielder reduces a creature to 0 or fewer hit points with the bloodstone impaler, she gains 5 temporary hit points for 1 minute.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, vampiric touch

Name: Bloodthirst Dagger
Description: This +1 dagger grants its wielder a +2 bonus on damage rolls against creatures that are bleeding. In addition, whenever the wielder reduces a bleeding creature to 0 or fewer hit points with this dagger, she gains 5 temporary hit points for 1 minute.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, vampiric touch

Name: Blood’s Edge
Description: This +1 falchion thirsts for blood. On a successful hit against a bleeding creature, the wielder gains a +2 bonus on damage rolls. On a confirmed critical hit against a bleeding creature, the target must succeed at a DC 16 Fortitude save or take 1d4 points of Constitution damage.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bleed, vampiric touch

Name: Boarding Pike of Repelling
Description: This +1 boarding pike grants its wielder a +4 bonus on combat maneuver checks to bull rush creatures attempting to board her vessel. Once per day, as a standard action, the wielder can create a gust of wind (as the spell) originating from the pike’s tip.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, gust of wind

Name: Boneshaking Cleaver
Description: This +1 greataxe rattles with necromantic power. On a successful hit against a living creature, the target must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or be shaken for 1 round. On a confirmed critical hit, the target is frightened for 1 round instead.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cause fear

Name: Boulderhead Mace
Description: This +1 heavy mace is topped with a massive stone head. Three times per day, on a successful hit, the wielder can attempt a bull rush combat maneuver against the target as a free action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity. The wielder uses her base attack bonus + her Strength modifier to determine her CMB for this bull rush attempt.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bull’s strength

Name: Bow of Ashes
Description: This +1 flaming composite longbow (+2 Str bonus) leaves a trail of ash in its wake. On a successful hit, the arrow turns to ash after striking. Three times per day, the wielder can cause an arrow fired from the bow to explode in a 5-foot-radius burst, dealing 2d6 points of fire damage to all creatures in the area (Reflex DC 14 half).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fireball

Name: Bow of the Wintermoon
Description: This +1 frost composite longbow (+2 Str bonus) sheds light as a torch when drawn. On a successful critical hit, the target is slowed (as the spell) for 1 round (Fortitude DC 14 negates).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, frost, slow

Name: Brilliant Rapier
Description: This +2 brilliant energy rapier allows its wielder to ignore nonliving matter when making melee attacks. Armor and shield bonuses to AC (including enhancement bonuses to that armor) do not count against it because the weapon passes through armor. (Dexterity, deflection, dodge, natural armor, and other such bonuses still apply.) A brilliant rapier cannot harm undead, constructs, or objects.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, brilliant energy, daylight

Name: Brine's Sting
Description: This +1 trident is etched with wave patterns. On a successful hit, the wielder can attempt a free reposition combat maneuver that does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Once per day, the wielder can cast hydraulic push (CL 9th) from the trident.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, hydraulic push

Name: Broken Blade
Description: This +1 adamantine longsword appears shattered, with only half its blade remaining. Three times per day, when the wielder confirms a critical hit, she can sunder the target’s armor or shield as a free action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, shatter

Name: Bullet, Alchemist's
Description: This +1 alchemical bullet bursts on impact, dealing an additional 1d6 points of fire damage to the target and 1 point of splash damage to creatures adjacent to the target.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, alchemist's fire

Name: Bullet, Boulder
Description: This +1 bullet strikes with tremendous force. On a successful hit, the target must succeed at a DC 14 Fortitude save or be knocked prone.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bull’s strength

Name: Bullet, Dispelling
Description: This +1 bullet attempts to dispel one spell effect on the target as dispel magic (CL 5th) on a successful hit.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, dispel magic

Name: Bullet, Dizzying
Description: This +1 bullet leaves its target reeling. On a successful hit, the target must succeed at a DC 14 Fortitude save or be staggered for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, daze

Name: Bullet, Dustburst
Description: This +1 bullet bursts into a cloud of choking dust on impact. The target and all creatures adjacent to it must succeed at a DC 14 Fortitude save or be blinded for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, glitterdust

Name: Bullet, Dwindling
Description: This +1 bullet causes its target to shrink. On a successful hit, the target must succeed at a DC 14 Fortitude save or be reduced in size as if affected by reduce person for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, reduce person

Name: Bullet, Tracer
Description: This +1 bullet leaves a glowing mark on its target. On a successful hit, the target glows as though affected by faerie fire for 1 minute.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, faerie fire

Name: Burning Glaive
Description: This +1 flaming glaive is warm to the touch. Three times per day, on a successful hit, the wielder can command the weapon to erupt in flames. The target must succeed at a DC 15 Reflex save or catch fire.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, flame blade

Name: Burrowing Bullet
Description: This +1 bullet burrows into the flesh of its target on a successful hit. The bullet continues to deal 1 point of bleed damage each round until removed with a successful DC 15 Heal check or magical healing is applied.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bleed

Name: Calistrian Kiss
Description: This +1 keen whip bears a tiny golden wasp charm near its hilt. On a successful critical hit, the target must succeed at a DC 16 Fortitude save or be staggered for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, hold person

Name: Cavalryman's Bow
Description: This +1 composite longbow (+2 Str bonus) grants its wielder a +2 competence bonus on Ride checks. Once per day, the wielder can cast mount (CL 9th) as a standard action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, mount

Name: Censuring Placard
Description: This +1 heavy wooden shield bears a symbol of stern judgment. Three times per day, when the wielder successfully performs a shield bash, the target must succeed at a DC 15 Will save or be silenced (as silence, centered on the target) for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, silence

Name: Cerebrum Drill
Description: This +1 heavy pick bores into the mind as well as the body. On a successful critical hit, the target must succeed at a DC 15 Will save or take 1d4 points of Intelligence damage.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, mind thrust I

Name: Channeler's Aspergillum
Description: This +1 aspergillum enhances channel energy. When the wielder channels positive energy to damage undead, she adds 1d6 points of damage to the total rolled. When channeling negative energy to harm living creatures, the DC of the save increases by 1. These effects apply only while the weapon is wielded.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, channel energy class feature

Name: Clicking Blade
Description: This +1 short sword emits an unsettling clicking noise when swung. On a successful hit, the target must succeed at a DC 15 Will save or be shaken for 1 round. On a confirmed critical hit, the target is frightened for 1 round instead.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, scare

Name: Cloak and Dagger
Description: This +1 dagger grants its wielder a +5 competence bonus on Sleight of Hand checks made to conceal the dagger on her body. Three times per day, the wielder can use invisibility (self only) as a swift action immediately after hitting a target with the dagger.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, invisibility

Name: Closing Offer
Description: This +1 dagger grants its wielder a +5 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks to influence attitudes. On a successful hit against a creature that is not hostile, the target must succeed at a DC 15 Will save or be charmed (as charm person) for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, charm person

Name: Cold Iron Longsword of Light
Description: This +1 cold iron longsword sheds light as a torch when drawn. Three times per day, the wielder can command the blade to blaze with brilliant radiance. For 1 round, the sword functions as a brilliant energy weapon.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, daylight

Name: Constrictor's Gauntlets
Description: These +1 gauntlets grant the wearer a +2 competence bonus on combat maneuver checks to grapple. On a successful grapple check, the wearer deals an additional 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, beast shape I

Name: Cornerstone Crossbow
Description: This +1 heavy crossbow grants its wielder a +4 bonus on attack rolls made against creatures attempting to breach a structure or break objects. Once per day, as a standard action, the wielder can fire a bolt that functions as make whole (CL 9th) on a touched object instead of dealing damage.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, make whole

Name: Courtesan's Ire
Description: This +1 dagger grants its wielder a +5 competence bonus on Bluff checks. On a successful hit against a creature that is not flat-footed, the target must succeed at a DC 15 Will save or become confused for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, confusion

Name: Crimson Bluff
Description: This +1 scimitar grants its wielder a +5 competence bonus on Intimidate checks. On a successful hit, the target must succeed at a DC 15 Will save or be shaken for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fear

Name: Crusader's Longsword
Description: This +1 longsword deals an extra 1d6 points of damage against evil creatures. On a confirmed critical hit against an evil creature, the target must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or be blinded for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, holy smite

Name: Crusader’s Quill
Description: This +1 arrow can dispel darkness. On a successful hit, the arrow attempts to dispel any darkness spell affecting the target as dispel magic (CL 9th).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, dispel magic

Name: Cutthroat's Apprentice
Description: This +1 dagger grants its wielder a +2 bonus on damage rolls against flat-footed opponents. On a confirmed critical hit against a flat-footed opponent, the target must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or take 1d4 points of Constitution damage.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, vampiric touch

Name: Dagger of Black Sands
Description: This +1 dagger leaves a trail of black sand in its wake. On a successful hit, the target must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or take 1 point of Constitution damage. The sand created by the dagger dissipates after 1 minute.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, ray of enfeeblement

Name: Dagger of Doubling
Description: This +1 dagger can be thrown as a ranged attack with a range increment of 10 feet. Once per day, when the dagger is thrown, it splits into two identical daggers in midair. Both daggers use the same attack roll result to determine success and deal damage independently.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, mirror image

Name: Dagger of Repossession
Description: This +1 dagger returns to its wielder’s hand at the end of the round if thrown. Once per day, when the dagger successfully hits a creature, the wielder can attempt to disarm the target as a free action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, telekinesis

Name: Dagger of Venom
Description: This +1 dagger allows the wielder to envenom the blade once per day as a swift action. The next successful hit forces the target to succeed at a DC 14 Fortitude save or take 1d6 points of Constitution damage.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, poison

Name: Dagger, Adamantine
Description: This adamantine dagger ignores hardness less than 20 when sundering weapons or attacking objects.

Name: Dancing Scimitar
Description: This +2 dancing scimitar can be loosed to attack on its own. It fights for 4 rounds as if wielded by its owner, using the owner’s base attack bonus and Strength modifier. When its duration expires, it falls to the ground. If grasped, it can be commanded to resume dancing.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, dancing, animate objects

Name: Dancing Wasp
Description: This +1 dagger hums softly. Three times per day, as a swift action, the wielder can cause the blade to buzz with distracting energy. On a successful hit, the target must succeed at a DC 15 Will save or be dazzled for 1d4 rounds.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, glitterdust

Name: Dart of Recovery
Description: This +1 dart heals its wielder. On a successful hit, the wielder regains 1d6 hit points. This healing can occur only once per round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cure moderate wounds

Name: Deadflesh Waraxe
Description: This +1 dwarven waraxe deals an extra 1d6 points of damage against undead. On a confirmed critical hit against an undead creature, the target must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or be staggered for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, searing light

Name: Deck of Slivering Fate
Description: This +1 throwing starknife is etched with arcane runes resembling playing cards. Three times per day, as a standard action, the wielder can throw a phantom copy of the starknife that deals force damage instead of its normal damage type.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, magic missile

Name: Defender’s Bastard Sword
Description: This +1 defending bastard sword grants its wielder a +2 shield bonus to AC against ranged attacks. The wielder can transfer some or all of the sword’s enhancement bonus to her AC as a shield bonus as a free action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, shield

Name: Demonsorrow Curve Blade
Description: This +2 holy elven curve blade deals an extra 2d6 points of damage against evil outsiders. On a confirmed critical hit against an evil outsider, the target must succeed at a DC 18 Will save or be banished as if by dismissal (CL 13th).

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, holy aura, dismissal

Name: Density Hammer
Description: This +1 warhammer can alter its density. As a swift action three times per day, the wielder can cause the hammer to become incredibly dense for 1 round. During this time, the hammer deals damage as though it were one size category larger.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, enlarge person

Name: Devil Catcher
Description: This +1 ranseur is designed to entangle fiends. On a successful hit against an outsider with the evil subtype, the wielder can attempt a free disarm or trip combat maneuver that does not provoke attacks of opportunity. This ability can be used three times per day.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, dimensional anchor

Name: Devil's Key
Description: This +1 dagger can unlock any mundane lock on a successful hit against it, as if the wielder had succeeded at a Disable Device check with a result of 30. Three times per day, the wielder can cast knock (CL 9th) as a standard action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, knock

Name: Dignity’s Barb
Description: This +1 starknife grants its wielder a +2 bonus on saving throws against fear effects. On a successful hit against a creature that is shaken, frightened, or panicked, the target must succeed at a DC 15 Will save or have the fear condition suppressed for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, remove fear

Name: Disarming Blade
Description: This +1 rapier grants its wielder a +4 bonus on combat maneuver checks to disarm opponents. Once per day, on a successful hit, the wielder can attempt to disarm the target as a free action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, telekinesis

Name: Doppelganger's Sword
Description: This +2 longsword can assume the appearance of any other sword of the same size. Three times per day, the wielder can cast disguise self (self only) as a swift action while holding the sword.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, disguise self, major image

Name: Dragoncatch Guisarme
Description: This +1 guisarme grants its wielder a +4 bonus on combat maneuver checks to trip creatures of the dragon type. In addition, when used to trip a dragon, the wielder does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bull’s strength

Name: Dragon's Doom
Description: This +2 dragon-bane greatsword deals an extra 2d6 points of damage against creatures of the dragon type. On a confirmed critical hit against a dragon, the target must succeed at a DC 18 Fortitude save or be stunned for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, summon monster I

Name: Dragon's Tail
Description: This +1 whip crackles with draconic energy. On a successful hit, the target takes an additional 1d6 points of electricity damage. Once per day, the wielder can cast shocking grasp (CL 9th) through the whip.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, shocking grasp

Name: Dragonbleeder
Description: This +1 lance causes dragons to bleed. On a successful hit against a dragon, the target takes 1 point of bleed damage. This bleed damage stacks with itself and lasts until healed normally.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bleed

Name: Duel Master's Edge
Description: This +1 rapier grants its wielder a +2 insight bonus on initiative checks. When fighting defensively or using the total defense action, the wielder gains an additional +1 dodge bonus to AC.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cat’s grace

Name: Duelist's Comate
Description: This +1 short sword grants its wielder a +2 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks made to tumble through threatened squares. Once per day, the wielder can cast expeditious retreat (CL 9th) as a swift action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, expeditious retreat

Name: Duelist’s Rapier
Description: This +1 rapier grants its wielder a +2 bonus on initiative checks and a +2 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks to move through threatened squares.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cat’s grace

Name: Dust Bolt
Description: This +1 crossbow bolt explodes in a cloud of dust on impact. On a successful hit, the target and all creatures adjacent to it must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or be blinded for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, glitterdust

Name: Dwarf Smasher
Description: This +1 earth breaker deals an extra 1d6 points of damage against dwarves. On a confirmed critical hit against a dwarf, the target must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or be knocked prone.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bull’s strength

Name: Dwarfbond Hammer
Description: This +1 warhammer grants its wielder a +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks to sunder objects. In addition, once per day, the wielder can strike the ground as a standard action to create a shock wave. All creatures within 10 feet must succeed at a DC 14 Reflex save or be knocked prone.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, shatter

Name: Dwarven Thrower
Description: This +2 returning dwarven warhammer gains a +2 bonus on attack and damage rolls when wielded by a dwarf. The hammer can be thrown with a range increment of 30 feet and returns to the wielder’s hand at the end of the round. Against giants, the hammer deals an extra 2d6 points of damage.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, returning, righteous might

Name: Eagle's Blade
Description: This +1 falchion grants its wielder a +2 bonus on Perception checks. Once per day, the wielder can cast fly (CL 9th) on herself as a standard action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fly

Name: Earth Breaker of Righted Injustice
Description: This +2 axiomatic earth breaker deals an extra 2d6 points of damage against chaotic creatures. On a confirmed critical hit against a chaotic creature, the target must succeed at a DC 18 Will save or be paralyzed for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, order’s wrath

Name: Earthenflail

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, detect evil

Name: Triple-Stinging Blade
Description: This +2 longsword strikes three times in quick succession. Once per day, the wielder can make two additional attacks at her highest base attack bonus as a full-round action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, haste

Name: Triton's Trident
Description: This +2 trident grants its wielder a swim speed of 30 feet and the ability to breathe water while wielded. Once per day, the wielder can cast control water (CL 13th) as a standard action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, control water, water breathing

Name: Undercutting Axe
Description: This +2 greataxe ignores hardness when used to sunder objects and deals double damage to objects. Once per day, the wielder can cast shatter (CL 13th) as a standard action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, shatter

Name: Valor's Minion
Description: This +2 longsword deals an additional 2d6 points of damage against creatures that are shaken, frightened, or panicked. Once per day, the wielder can cast heroism (CL 13th) as a standard action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, heroism

Name: Valorous Blade
Description: This +2 longsword deals double damage on a charge. Once per day, the wielder can cast righteous might (CL 13th) as a standard action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, righteous might

Name: Vaultbow
Description: This +2 longbow grants its wielder a +4 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks made to jump. Once per day, the wielder can cast fly (CL 13th) as a standard action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fly

Name: Vengeance's Edge
Description: This +2 short sword deals an additional 2d6 points of damage against creatures that have reduced the wielder below half her maximum hit points within the last minute. Once per day, the wielder can cast vampiric touch (CL 13th) as a standard action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, vampiric touch

Name: Venomous Whisper Dart
Description: This +1 dart carries a subtle toxin. On a successful hit, the target must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or take 1d2 points of Constitution damage.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, poison

Name: Vindictive Harpoon
Description: This +2 harpoon deals an additional 2d6 points of damage against creatures that have damaged the wielder within the last round. Once per day, the wielder can cast rage (CL 13th) as a standard action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, rage

Name: Void Scythe
Description: This +2 scythe deals an additional 2d6 points of negative energy damage on a successful hit. Once per day, the wielder can cast enervation (CL 13th) as a standard action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, enervation

Name: Vulnerability Bolt
Description: This +1 crossbow bolt weakens resistance. On a successful hit, the target takes a –5 penalty on saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities until the end of the wielder’s next turn.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bestow curse

Name: Wanderer's Scarf
Description: This +1 scarf grants its wielder a +2 competence bonus on Survival checks. Once per day, the wielder can cast endure elements (CL 9th) as a standard action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, endure elements

Name: Wandering Punishment
Description: This +2 heavy flail deals an additional 2d6 points of damage against creatures that have fled from the wielder within the last round. Once per day, the wielder can cast hold monster (CL 13th) as a standard action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, hold monster

Name: War Lance
Description: This +2 lance deals double damage on a mounted charge (this stacks with the normal lance damage multiplier). Once per day, the wielder can cast haste (CL 13th) as a standard action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, haste

Name: Warbringer
Description: This +2 longsword grants its wielder a +2 competence bonus on Intimidate checks. Once per day, the wielder can cast fear (CL 13th) as a standard action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fear

Name: Wasp's Kiss
Description: This +1 dagger injects a painful toxin. On a successful hit, the target must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or take 1d3 points of Constitution damage.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, poison

Name: Waterblight Scepter
Description: This +2 heavy mace drips with brackish water. On a successful hit, the target takes an additional 2d6 points of acid damage. Once per day, the wielder can cast control water (CL 13th) as a standard action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, control water

Name: Whispering Shrike
Description: This +2 starknife makes no sound when thrown. The wielder gains a +4 competence bonus on Stealth checks while wielding it. Once per day, the wielder can cast silence (CL 13th) as a standard action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, silence

Name: Windreader's Bow
Description: This +2 longbow ignores wind penalties to ranged attacks. Once per day, the wielder can cast gust of wind (CL 13th) as a standard action.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, gust of wind

Name: Withershot
Description: This +2 longbow fires arrows that sap vitality. On a successful hit, the target must succeed at a DC 18 Fortitude save or take 1d4 points of Strength damage.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, ray of enfeeblement

Name: Wizard Hook
Description: This +2 grappling hook functions as a light pick in combat. Once per day, the wielder can cast dimension door (CL 13th) as a standard action, but must arrive adjacent to a solid surface.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, dimension door
